narrative.text: Merchant MID100069 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 722 days ago. Telemetry agrees: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are velocity_recent at +5.5 sigma (observed 2.59 against a category baseline of 1.65), velocity_all at +4.2 sigma (observed 2.37 against a category baseline of 1.66), round_share_drift at +2.8 sigma (observed 0.0558 against a category baseline of 0.00022). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.93 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. The storefront also carries text addressed to an automated reviewer, which was recorded as a suspicion signal and not acted on as an instruction. In total 1 independent view of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier is a merchant verification call. Settlements continue: one dissenting view is enough to ask, not to hold. A model is 0.93 confident, but only 1 independent view dissents -- model confidence is not evidence agreement, and the action reflects the latter.
